title: Do I have to stop using TrainingPeaks?
seoTitle: Using augo Alongside TrainingPeaks | augo support
description: No. augo is designed to sit alongside your existing training platform, not replace it.
summary: No. augo works on top of the tools you already use — keep TrainingPeaks for workout planning and let augo handle communication, session feedback and the insight around it. There is no migration to do.

body.html: No, and augo isn’t trying to make you. The design assumption is that you already have a training platform that works and a set of athletes who know how to use it.

What augo does instead

augo sits in the middle of your existing setup. You keep TrainingPeaks for workout planning. Athletes keep their Garmin or Coros for tracking. augo centralises the communication, the session feedback and the insight — the parts that currently scatter across WhatsApp, email and your memory.

What augo doesn’t do today

Being explicit about the gaps, because they matter to the decision:

  • Workout prescription and plan building — planned for 1 September 2026. Until then augo is the layer around your training platform rather than a replacement for it.
  • CTL, ATL, TSB and the Performance Management Chart — not offered, deliberately.
  • TSS-style load modelling and deep chart analysis — not offered.
  • A training plan marketplace — not offered.

If you do want to move

Nothing stops you consolidating later. Your data is exportable in full at any time, from augo and generally from your current platform too. But you don’t need to decide that now to start using augo.

faqs.question: Is augo a full replacement for TrainingPeaks?
faqs.answer: Not today. Workout prescription is planned for 1 September 2026; until then augo is designed to work alongside your training platform rather than replace it.

faqs.question: Does augo have CTL, ATL and TSB?
faqs.answer: No, and not by design. augo focuses on communication, session feedback and surfacing which athlete needs attention, rather than on load modelling charts.

faqs.question: Do I have to migrate my athletes to start?
faqs.answer: No. Athletes keep their existing devices and you keep your existing planning tool. There is no migration step.
